components.name: Floating navigation
components.description: Centered 70dvh expanded navigation; focused rail uses compact automatic height.
components.css: .nav-demo{font-family:'Manrope Variable',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#172b50);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--glass-highlight,rgba(255,255,255,.44)),transparent 65%),var(--glass,rgba(244,250,255,.28));border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,rgba(255,255,255,.74));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff70,var(--glass-depth,0 14px 34px #294e8921);backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%);width:196px;padding:26px 14px;height:70dvh;max-height:70dvh;align-self:center;border-radius:30px;display:grid;gap:6px}.nav-demo button{font:700 13px Manrope,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);border:0;background:none;border-radius:14px;min-height:44px;padding:12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s}.nav-demo button[aria-current]{color:var(--accent,#315dec);background:var(--selected,#e8efff);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80,0 3px 9px #23477608}.nav-demo button:hover{background:var(--selected,#e8efff);transform:translateX(2px)}.nav-demo button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nav-demo button{transition:none;transform:none}}

components.name: Study modes
components.description: One measured glass indicator slides behind the selected button; static example shows its selected position.
components.css: .mode-demo{position:relative;display:flex;gap:2px;padding:4px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--glass,rgba(244,250,255,.28));border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,#fff);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(165%)}.mode-demo .selection{position:absolute;left:4px;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:64px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.72),rgba(233,243,255,.32));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff,0 3px 10px #31538a12;transition:transform .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),width .34s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.mode-demo button{position:relative;font:700 11px Manrope,sans-serif;padding:10px 8px;border:0;border-radius:20px;background:none;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);cursor:pointer}.mode-demo button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--accent,#315dec)}.mode-demo button:hover{color:var(--accent,#315dec);background:#ffffff1f}.mode-demo button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}:host-context([data-theme=dark]) .selection{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(160,197,255,.22),rgba(144,181,242,.08));border-color:rgba(189,216,255,.32);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff45,0 4px 12px #040c2526}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mode-demo .selection{transition:none}}

components.name: Glass composer
components.description: Anchored writing surface with labelled Expand/Shrink control; live React state toggles expanded height.
components.css: .glass-composer{padding:12px 15px 10px;border:1px solid #cbd8ef;border-radius:18px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface,#fff) 62%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(145%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff70,0 8px 26px #2443740d}.glass-composer textarea{font:13px/1.6 Manrope,sans-serif;width:100%;height:33px;max-height:80px;resize:none;overflow:auto;border:0;outline:0;background:none;color:var(--text,#172b50)}.glass-composer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#425b7b)}.glass-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent,#315dec);box-shadow:0 5px 25px #315dec12}.glass-composer:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#315dec)}.glass-composer button{font:12px Manrope,sans-serif;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted,#425b7b);padding:6px;cursor:pointer}.glass-composer button:hover{background:var(--selected,#e8efff)}.glass-composer button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}.glass-composer textarea{transition:height .24s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.glass-composer.is-expanded textarea{height:clamp(70px,16dvh,150px);min-height:70px;max-height:150px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.glass-composer textarea{transition:none}}

components.name: Compact masthead
components.description: Independent focus pill and theme circle flank a centered heading; branding sits separately on the backdrop.
components.html:
Big questions. Clear answers.

Your notes, untangled.
components.css: .masthead-demo{font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(145px,1fr) auto minmax(44px,1fr);align-items:center;gap:16px;height:76px;color:var(--text,#172b50)}.masthead-demo div{text-align:center}.masthead-demo h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0}.masthead-demo p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted,#425b7b)}.masthead-demo button{font:650 12px Manrope,sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--glass-highlight,#ffffff70),transparent 65%),var(--glass,rgba(244,250,255,.28));border:1px solid var(--glass-edge,#ffffffbd);color:inherit;backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%);cursor:pointer}.masthead-demo .focus{justify-self:start;min-height:42px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:24px}.masthead-demo .theme{justify-self:end;width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:50%}.masthead-demo button:hover{background-color:var(--glass-highlight,#ffffff70);transform:translateY(-1px)}.masthead-demo button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #739af5;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: Blue-hour study desk: floating translucent navigation centers vertically, expanded to 70dvh while focus retains a compact rail. Existing Manrope branding and Phosphor BookOpen sit separately on the gradient backdrop. Independent focus and theme controls flank the centered full heading; no long topbar. Taller desktop starter tiles accompany the anchored expandable composer. A single measured glass indicator selects modes in both themes. Compact mobile and short-height layouts remain; offline truth stays visible in the composer and uploads remain in the library.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet surfaces with strong ink and fine borders
Friendly language with a direct focus mode
Separate upper-left brand, focus pill, centered heading and theme circle
Viewport-anchored composer and independently scrolling conversation
Semester, subject, category and document library hierarchy

rules.name: The Readable Blue Rule
rules.body: Keep running text on solid semantic surfaces; protect upload labels from bright gradient stops.

rules.name: The Quiet Desk Rule
rules.body: Use tone and borders for everyday cards, with stronger depth reserved for overlays and the paper illustration.

dos: Do use semantic colors in both themes.
Do preserve visible focus and readable answer width.
Do keep decorative personality removable in focus mode.
donts: Don't replace the blue family with unrelated decorative accents.
Don't use the gradient as a general reading surface.
Don't remove study features in focus mode.
Don't rely on motion or color alone for essential state.
